categories.main_business_segments: Zhiyang Innovation Technology Co., Ltd. focuses on AI-driven digital and intelligent transformation solutions across multiple industries including power, water conservancy, rail transit, and new energy. The company offers AI algorithms, big data analytics, IoT, digital twin, and embodied intelligence technologies, delivering integrated 'algorithm-software-hardware' products and solutions such as intelligent inspection systems, digital water management, and industrial AI models.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company develops six foundational technology platforms: one-stop AI platform, big data and digital twin platform, industrial large model platform, AI agent platform, AI terminal technology platform, and embodied intelligence drone platform. It employs advanced AI algorithms including large language models, multimodal models, and visual perception models, combined with edge computing, IoT connectivity, and cloud-edge collaboration. Production follows a project order-based model with in-house design and assembly of core intelligent terminals and communication modules.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are primarily from the power sector, including various levels of grid companies and their subsidiaries, accounting for over 58% of revenue. Other significant markets include water conservancy, rail transit, and new energy industries. The company serves government and enterprise clients engaged in infrastructure digitalization and intelligent operation management.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations cover all provincial-level regions in mainland China except Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan. Major revenue contributions come from East China, North China, Northwest China, Northeast China, Southwest China, Central China, and South China regions, reflecting a broad domestic market presence.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zhiyang Innovation operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the AI and industrial automation supply chain. It develops core AI algorithms and software platforms, designs and assembles intelligent hardware terminals, and delivers integrated AI solutions and services directly to end customers in various industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous R&D investment in AI algorithms, industrial large models, embodied intelligence, and intelligent hardware. It maintains four R&D centers across Jinan, Zibo, Beijing, and Guangzhou, focusing on cross-disciplinary innovation and industry-specific AI applications. Strategic initiatives include deepening AI integration in industry scenarios, expanding into new sectors, and enhancing ecosystem collaboration, especially with the OpenHarmony platform.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of AI solutions and intelligent hardware products, including project-based contracts via bidding, competitive negotiation, and business negotiation. The company also earns income from software development, technical services, and after-sales support.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Zhiyang Innovation is positioned as a leading domestic AI technology provider in power grid digitalization and intelligent operation, with expanding presence in water conservancy, rail transit, and new energy sectors. It holds a strong market share in AI terminal products for power inspection and has established a reputable brand recognized for technological innovation and comprehensive solutions. Specific competitors are not named in the report.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 970.7 million, a 21.62% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 51.3 million, up 23.6%. Total assets reached RMB 1.52 billion, growing 8.06%. R&D expenses accounted for 11.46% of revenue, reflecting sustained investment. The company maintains steady growth with expanding asset base and profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Zhiyang Innovation emphasizes its integrated AI technology platforms combining algorithms, software, and hardware to deliver end-to-end intelligent solutions tailored to industry-specific scenarios. Its competitive edge lies in proprietary industrial large models, multimodal AI capabilities, and embodied intelligence drones, enabling precise perception, cognition, and decision-making. The company’s solutions improve operational efficiency, safety, and predictive maintenance for critical infrastructure, supported by strong R&D and comprehensive service capabilities.
